text: The Vice President of Finance and Administration, TO Live will give a presentation on the 2020 staffing budget.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approved the 2020 Staffing Budget, as outlined in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 24, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 to the report (May 24, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live remain confidential in its entirety, as it is about labour relations or employee negotiations.
